content: Bitemporal/point-in-time modeling: track valid_time (period the fact is true in the real world, e.g. fiscal period) separately from transaction_time / as_of (when the record was captured/filed). Financial restatements are common (1700+ US restatements 2010-2020); storing only latest value corrupts historical backtests. Practical simplification for point-in-time fundamentals: one row per (ticker, fiscal_period, as_of_date) rather than full bitemporal, so historical queries select the value as known as-of a given date.
